_comment: Known RustSec advisories in Cargo.lock, recorded deliberately. This is a RATCHET floor, not an approval: every entry is an outstanding advisory. 'shipped' means the crate is reachable through non-dev dependencies of the program and therefore belongs to its real supply chain; the rest are test-harness only. Regenerate with `python3 scripts/cargo_audit_gate.py --update` only after reviewing the delta.

RUSTSEC-2022-0093.title: Double Public Key Signing Function Oracle Attack on `ed25519-dalek`

RUSTSEC-2026-0098.title: Name constraints for URI names were incorrectly accepted

RUSTSEC-2026-0099.title: Name constraints were accepted for certificates asserting a wildcard name

RUSTSEC-2026-0104.title: Reachable panic in certificate revocation list parsing

RUSTSEC-2026-0346.title: `Debug` impls for client session values expose TLS secrets

RUSTSEC-2026-0349.title: Unauthenticated ServerHello can downgrade later connections to classical key exchange

RUSTSEC-2026-0381.title: Bundled root certificates allow trust in distrusted emSign intermediates

RUSTSEC-2026-0382.title: Certificate verification may accept distrusted intermediates

RUSTSEC-2026-0391.title: Data from an abandoned stream leaks into the next stream on a reused context

RUSTSEC-2026-0398.title: `Seekable::decompress` sets a `Vec` length beyond its capacity for offsets past the end

RUSTSEC-2026-0403.title: Uninitialized memory exposed when streaming decompression of a legacy frame fails
